The public key an object holds

Source: R/binfhe-keys.R
get_public_key.Rd

For a BinFHEContext, the LWE public key among its bootstrapping keys, present after bin_bt_key_gen() with KeygenMode$PUB_ENCRYPT. For a SchemeSwitchingDataDeserializer, the CKKS public key it has read.

Usage

get_public_key(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A BinFHEContext or a SchemeSwitchingDataDeserializer.

...

Not used.

Value

An LWEPublicKey or a PublicKey, or NULL if the object holds none.

See also

get_bt_key()
